```plato

    // The feature point of spatial cell (ix, iy, iz), in cell-local coordinates.
    FeatureOffset3D(seed: Integer, ix: Integer, iy: Integer, iz: Integer, jitter: Number): Vector3D {
        var h = LatticeHash(seed, ix, iy, iz);
        var hx = HashToUnit(h);
        var hy = HashToUnit(NoiseMix(h));
        var hz = HashToUnit(NoiseMix(NoiseMix(h)));
        return (0.5 + (hx - 0.5) * jitter,
                0.5 + (hy - 0.5) * jitter,
                0.5 + (hz - 0.5) * jitter);
    }
```
